messages.content: You are the archival chair. The dated documentary sources define the factual scope of the supplement.

{"task": "Write exactly three short source-cited sentences. Begin sentence one with 'Resolution 2694 already authorized' and give Government–ELN monitoring and verification. Begin sentence two with 'The Council expressed willingness to consider' and give Government–EMC monitoring and verification if the Secretary-General confirms a ceasefire with appropriate verification protocols. Begin sentence three with 'The Council would take into account' and identify the Secretary-General's update on the implementation of resolution 2694. End with [ADDITIONAL].", "documentary_sources": {"ADDITIONAL": "Resolution 2704, final preambular paragraph. Resolution 2694 had already extended the Mission's role to monitoring and verification of the Government–ELN ceasefire. Resolution 2704 expressed willingness to consider Government–EMC monitoring and verification when the Secretary-General confirms a ceasefire with appropriate verification protocols and taking into account his update on implementation of resolution 2694."}, "documentary_fields": {"ADDITIONAL": {"existing_authority": "Resolution 2694 allowed monitoring and verification of the Government–ELN ceasefire", "Government–EMC legal stage": "willingness to consider later, with no verification granted here", "prerequisite": "Secretary-General confirmation of ceasefire with appropriate verification protocols", "separate_input": "take into account the Secretary-General's update on implementation of resolution 2694"}}, "provisional_notes": []}

output: Resolution 2694 already authorized Government–ELN monitoring and verification. The Council expressed willingness to consider Government–EMC monitoring and verification if the Secretary-General confirms a ceasefire with appropriate verification protocols. The Council would take into account the Secretary-General's update on the implementation of resolution 2694. [ADDITIONAL]
